title: MOSFET output characteristic
caption: With V_GS = 1.5 V and V_T = 0.5 V the overdrive is 1.0 V. The drain current rises with V_DS until V_DS = V_GS − V_T, then saturates at I_D = ½(μC_ox W/L)(V_GS − V_T)² = ½ × 2 × 1² = 1.0 mA.
alt: Drain current against drain–source voltage, rising in a curve to 1 milliamp at 1 volt and staying flat beyond it.
description: Triode region (V_DS < 1 V): I_D = k[(V_GS − V_T)V_DS − V_DS²/2].
At V_DS = 1 V the channel pinches off.
Saturation (V_DS > 1 V): I_D = 1 mA, independent of V_DS (channel-length modulation ignored).

checks.name: the triode curve meets saturation at 1 mA
the triode current peaks exactly at pinch-off
